Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The funeral procession rules sit on the first page of this range, after the end of the farm equipment material; they were taught here because this is the page where they appear [A01].
The speed table prints numbers without units; the surrounding text gives miles per hour, so the facts state mph [A02].
The curve steps say to gradually increase speed while rounding the curve; this is kept as printed and not softened.
The stopping figure at highway speed is stated for ideal conditions only, exactly as the handbook qualifies it.
